<a id="searchByText(com.here.sdk.search.TextQuery,com.here.sdk.search.SearchOptions,com.here.sdk.search.SearchCallback)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>searchByText</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-taskhandle" title="interface in com.here.sdk.core.threading">TaskHandle</a>&nbsp;searchByText&#8203;(@NonNull
                        <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-textquery" title="class in com.here.sdk.search">TextQuery</a>&nbsp;query,
                        @NonNull
                        <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-searchoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.search">SearchOptions</a>&nbsp;options,
                        @NonNull
                        <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-searchcallback" title="interface in com.here.sdk.search">SearchCallback</a>&nbsp;callback)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Performs an asynchronous text query search for <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-place" title="class in com.here.sdk.search"><code>Place</code></a> instances within a given <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-textquery-area" title="class in com.here.sdk.search"><code>TextQuery.Area</code></a>.
 The returned places are sorted by relevance.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>query</code> - <p>Desired free-form text query to search.</dd>
<dd><code>options</code> - <p>Search options.</dd>
<dd><code>callback</code> - <p>Callback which receives the result on the main thread.</dd>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>Handle that will be used to manipulate the execution of the task.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="searchByAddress(com.here.sdk.search.AddressQuery,com.here.sdk.search.SearchOptions,com.here.sdk.search.SearchCallback)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>searchByAddress</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-taskhandle" title="interface in com.here.sdk.core.threading">TaskHandle</a>&nbsp;searchByAddress&#8203;(@NonNull
                           <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-addressquery" title="class in com.here.sdk.search">AddressQuery</a>&nbsp;query,
                           @NonNull
                           <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-searchoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.search">SearchOptions</a>&nbsp;options,
                           @NonNull
                           <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-searchcallback" title="interface in com.here.sdk.search">SearchCallback</a>&nbsp;callback)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Performs an asynchronous address query search for <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-place" title="class in com.here.sdk.search"><code>Place</code></a> instances.
 This is the same type of search as forward geocoding, except that more data is returned
 than just the geographic coordinates of a given address. Note that an address can
 belong to more than one <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-place" title="class in com.here.sdk.search"><code>Place</code></a> result, although all found places will
 share the same geographic coordinates.
 The returned places are sorted by relevance.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>query</code> - <p>Desired free-form address query text to search.</dd>
<dd><code>options</code> - <p>Search options.</dd>
<dd><code>callback</code> - <p>Callback which receives the result on the main thread.</dd>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>Handle that will be used to manipulate the execution of the task.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="searchByCategory(com.here.sdk.search.CategoryQuery,com.here.sdk.search.SearchOptions,com.here.sdk.search.SearchCallback)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>searchByCategory</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-taskhandle" title="interface in com.here.sdk.core.threading">TaskHandle</a>&nbsp;searchByCategory&#8203;(@NonNull
                            <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-categoryquery" title="class in com.here.sdk.search">CategoryQuery</a>&nbsp;query,
                            @NonNull
                            <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-searchoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.search">SearchOptions</a>&nbsp;options,
                            @NonNull
                            <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-searchcallback" title="interface in com.here.sdk.search">SearchCallback</a>&nbsp;callback)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Performs an asynchronous category search for <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-place" title="class in com.here.sdk.search"><code>Place</code></a> instances.
 A list containing at least one <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-placecategory" title="class in com.here.sdk.search"><code>PlaceCategory</code></a> must be provided
 as part of the <code>query</code>.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>query</code> - <p>Query with list of desired categories.</dd>
<dd><code>options</code> - <p>Search options.</dd>
<dd><code>callback</code> - <p>Callback which receives the result on the main thread.</dd>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>Handle that will be used to manipulate the execution of the task.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="searchByCoordinates(com.here.sdk.core.GeoCoordinates,com.here.sdk.search.SearchOptions,com.here.sdk.search.SearchCallback)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>searchByCoordinates</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-taskhandle" title="interface in com.here.sdk.core.threading">TaskHandle</a>&nbsp;searchByCoordinates&#8203;(@NonNull
                               <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geocoordinates" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">GeoCoordinates</a>&nbsp;coordinates,
                               @NonNull
                               <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-searchoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.search">SearchOptions</a>&nbsp;options,
                               @NonNull
                               <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-searchcallback" title="interface in com.here.sdk.search">SearchCallback</a>&nbsp;callback)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Performs an asynchronous search for <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-place" title="class in com.here.sdk.search"><code>Place</code></a> instances based on the given
 geographic coordinates.
 This is the same search type as reverse geocoding, except that more data is returned
 than just the <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-address" title="class in com.here.sdk.search"><code>Address</code></a> related to the given coordinates.
 Note that more than one <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-place" title="class in com.here.sdk.search"><code>Place</code></a> can be related to the given coordinates.
 The returned places are sorted by relevance.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>coordinates</code> - <p>The coordinates where to search.</dd>
<dd><code>options</code> - <p>Search options.</dd>
<dd><code>callback</code> - <p>Callback which receives result on the main thread.</dd>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>Handle that will be used to manipulate execution of the task.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="searchByPlaceId(com.here.sdk.search.PlaceIdQuery,com.here.sdk.core.LanguageCode,com.here.sdk.search.PlaceIdSearchCallback)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>searchByPlaceId</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-taskhandle" title="interface in com.here.sdk.core.threading">TaskHandle</a>&nbsp;searchByPlaceId&#8203;(@NonNull
                           <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-placeidquery" title="class in com.here.sdk.search">PlaceIdQuery</a>&nbsp;query,
                           @Nullable
                           <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-languagecode" title="enum in com.here.sdk.core">LanguageCode</a>&nbsp;languageCode,
                           @NonNull
                           <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-placeidsearchcallback" title="interface in com.here.sdk.search">PlaceIdSearchCallback</a>&nbsp;callback)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Performs an asynchronous search for a <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-place" title="class in com.here.sdk.search"><code>Place</code></a> based on its ID and
 <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-languagecode" title="enum in com.here.sdk.core"><code>LanguageCode</code></a>.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>query</code> - <p>The id of place to search.</dd>
<dd><code>languageCode</code> - <p>The preferred language for the search results. When unset or unsupported language is chosen,
     results will be returned in their local language.</dd>
<dd><code>callback</code> - <p>Callback which receives the result on the main thread.</dd>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>Handle that will be used to manipulate the execution of the task.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="searchByPickedPlace(com.here.sdk.core.PickedPlace,com.here.sdk.core.LanguageCode,com.here.sdk.search.PlaceIdSearchCallback)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>searchByPickedPlace</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-taskhandle" title="interface in com.here.sdk.core.threading">TaskHandle</a>&nbsp;searchByPickedPlace&#8203;(@NonNull
                               <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-pickedplace" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">PickedPlace</a>&nbsp;pickedPlace,
                               @Nullable
                               <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-languagecode" title="enum in com.here.sdk.core">LanguageCode</a>&nbsp;languageCode,
                               @NonNull
                               <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-placeidsearchcallback" title="interface in com.here.sdk.search">PlaceIdSearchCallback</a>&nbsp;callback)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Performs an asynchronous search for a <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-place" title="class in com.here.sdk.search"><code>Place</code></a> based on the content found in <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-pickedplace" title="class in com.here.sdk.core"><code>PickedPlace</code></a>.
 If <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-pickedplace" title="class in com.here.sdk.core"><code>PickedPlace</code></a> data is obtained from the offline map, it may happen that the newer version
 that is used by the online service represented by <code>SearchEngine</code> no longer contains the
 related POI. In that case, <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-searcherror#NO_RESULTS_FOUND"><code>SearchError.NO_RESULTS_FOUND</code></a> error is reported.
 When that happens, you may try to obtain the POI from the offline map by calling
 <code>OfflineSearchEngine.searchByPickedPlace</code>. Note that not all editions include the
 <code>OfflineSearchEngine</code>.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>pickedPlace</code> - <p>The content picked from map.</dd>
<dd><code>languageCode</code> - <p>The preferred language for the search result. When unset or unsupported language is chosen,
     result will be returned in the local language.</dd>
<dd><code>callback</code> - <p>Callback which receives the result on the main thread.</dd>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>Handle that will be used to manipulate the execution of the task.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="suggestByText(com.here.sdk.search.TextQuery,com.here.sdk.search.SearchOptions,com.here.sdk.search.SuggestCallback)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>suggestByText</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-taskhandle" title="interface in com.here.sdk.core.threading">TaskHandle</a>&nbsp;suggestByText&#8203;(@NonNull
                         <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-textquery" title="class in com.here.sdk.search">TextQuery</a>&nbsp;query,
                         @NonNull
                         <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-searchoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.search">SearchOptions</a>&nbsp;options,
                         @NonNull
                         <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-suggestcallback" title="interface in com.here.sdk.search">SuggestCallback</a>&nbsp;callback)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Performs an asynchronous request to suggest places for text queries and
 returns suggestions sorted by relevance.
 <p>Note that while <code>OfflineSearchEngine</code> includes as many details as are available,
 <code>SearchEngine</code> includes only the information that is relevant for autosuggest use cases.
 Complete details can be obtained by searching with <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-placeidquery" title="class in com.here.sdk.search"><code>PlaceIdQuery</code></a>.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>query</code> - <p>Desired text query to search.</dd>
<dd><code>options</code> - <p>Search options.</dd>
<dd><code>callback</code> - <p>Callback which receives the result on the main thread.</dd>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>Handle that will be used to manipulate the execution of the task.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</section>
</li>
</ul>
